reason: Our current ERP works well enough, and moving fees, attendance and report cards to new software in the middle of the session could go wrong right when parents are watching. Even at half price, Rs 30,000 plus GST is over my Rs 25,000 limit, so it goes to the trust chairman, and I can't defend that to him for something we don't need right now.
objection: Switching mid-session is risky. If fee receipts or report cards break, I take the blame. And with my strength of around 900 students, the full price after the first year comes to more than a lakh, so the launch offer only covers year one.
would_change_my_mind: A free on-site demo at our school, with you migrating our existing data for us, a switch timed for the new session in April, and a fixed multi-year per-student price that keeps it under Rs 25,000 a year so I can sign without the chairman.
